exampleEn: After a long argument, she decided to give in and agree with him.
exampleKo: 긴 논쟁 끝에 그녀는 항복하고 그에게 동의하기로 했다.
gameExamples: He was stubborn at first, but eventually he had to give in to their demands.
Despite her reluctance, she chose to give in and let him help her.
It was hard for him to give in, but he realized that teamwork was important.
